lines.text: Kroki does, a service that renders diagrams from text. Antoine built a Next.js interface around it: an editor on one side, a live preview on the other.

lines.text: A server route. It checks the diagram type and the output format you asked for, encodes your source, and fetches the rendered image from Kroki.
